BiblicalUsage: Zelzah was a place on the border of Benjamin, by Rachel's sepulchre. Samuel told Saul he would find two men there with news of the asses, as the first sign that he would be king. The town is named once, as the place where a farmer learned he was chosen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives signs on ordinary roads — at Zelzah, by a grave, two men with news. Saul's kingdom began with a small meeting at a named place.
